title: quercus longipedunculata var. fastigiata
intro: Quercus longipedunculata var. fastigiata, commonly known as the fastigiate oak or narrow-leaved evergreen oak, is a variety of evergreen oak tree that belongs to the beech family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, that may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Quercus longipedunculata var. fastigiata include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
